$description: Component tokens for Skeleton. Path grammar: skeleton.<part>.<property>[.<shape>]. Parts, options and states must exist in packages/components/specs/components/skeleton.spec.json. Values alias semantic tokens only (Figma library mapped colors and scales, and the additions).

height.$description: Default height when none is given: a line of body text, a square avatar, a block.

opacity.$description: Low point of the pulse; the high point is fully opaque.
